landing.sous_titre: A level test, a revision plan and corrected exercises for {{nombre}} English, French and German exams.
landing.cta_essayer: Try an exercise — no account needed
landing.reassurance: When you sign up: 7 days of unlimited exercises, no card needed. Then 3 exercises a day, for free.
landing.choix_titre: Try an exercise, no account needed
landing.choix_aide: Tap your exam: a real exercise opens right away.
landing.choix_note: Corrected with explanations, and nothing is saved.
landing.choix_aria: Try a {{examen}} exercise, no account needed
landing.video_jouer_aria: Watch the introduction video, 34 seconds, with sound.
landing.video_affiche_alt: The video’s presenter, with the title “Language exam: where to start?” in French
landing.video_fin_texte: A real exercise, corrected with explanations. No account needed.
landing.etapes_chapo: What the video says, in plain words.
landing.etape_1_texte: IELTS, DELF, Goethe, telc… Each exam has its own structure, part by part, as the exam board publishes it.
landing.etape_2_texte: A level test, from beginner to C2, then what you should work on first.
landing.etape_3_texte: A revision plan and corrected exercises, with an explanation for every mistake. Your mistakes come back for review until you have mastered them.
landing.etape_voir_aria: Watch this part of the video, at {{secondes}} seconds
landing.essai_chapo: Choose your exam, answer a real exercise in the real player, and read the correction of each question with its explanation. No account, and your answers are not kept.
landing.essai_aucun: No exercise is open for trial for {{examen}} yet. Create your free account to practise it, or look at its official structure.
landing.essai_note: The trial covers exercises with fixed answers. Writing and speaking are corrected by AI: they need an account.
landing.essai_note_francais: Instructions and explanations are written in French.
landing.epreuves_chapo: The four papers shown in the video, and what the app does with them.
landing.epreuve_redaction_texte: Your essay is marked against your exam’s criteria, with every mistake corrected and explained.
landing.epreuve_ecoute_texte: Recordings in the format of the paper, corrected question by question, with explanations.
landing.epreuve_oral_texte: You record yourself: your answer is transcribed, then commented on — what is missing, what to correct.
landing.epreuve_maison_texte: In your browser, on a phone or a computer, with nothing to install.
landing.epreuves_note_ia: Writing and speaking are corrected by an AI (Mistral): its marks guide your work, they do not replace the exam’s.
landing.tarifs_chapo: The only difference between the two plans: the number of exercises per day.
landing.tarif_tout_inclus: Everything else is included: level test, revision plan, explained corrections, writing and speaking correction, review of your mistakes.
landing.tarif_pas_sur: Not sure yet? Try an exercise without an account
landing.tarif_ou_an: or {{annuel}} per year, i.e. {{parMois}} per month
landing.tarif_plus_memes: The same tools as the free plan
landing.tarifs_note: When you sign up: 7 days of unlimited exercises, no card needed (once per e-mail address). Secure payment by Stripe, cancel at any time.
landing.centres_chapo: Create your classes, set homework, and see who did the work, when, and where each student struggles.
landing.centres_classes_texte: Your students join their class with a code.
landing.centres_devoirs_texte: Exercises from the library or your own, with a due date.
landing.centres_suivi_texte: What they did, when, their answers, their weak points in writing and speaking — and a CSV export.
landing.centres_exercices_texte: Written by hand or from an AI draft, with your own images and audio.
landing.centres_equipe_texte: Invite your teachers; one person can manage several schools.
landing.dernier_chapo: One exercise, its correction, its explanations. No account, and your answers are not kept.
landing.footer_tagline: Preparation for English, French and German exams: {{nombre}} exams.
landing.footer_independance: PrePla is independent of the exam boards: it issues no certificate and sells no exam registration.
